section_summary: This section contains one-page profiles of Japanese machine-tool and precision-equipment manufacturers. Pages 321–362 list firms with capitalization figures; page 363 introduces firms whose capitalization is unknown, followed by profiles through page 400. The entries give products and plant locations, usually without employment or production estimates.
